# Mobile timetable regression fixture

Place a privacy-reviewed, redacted phone timetable screenshot in this folder
before testing the real school layout. The user-provided screenshot is not
present in the current workspace, so no real image is read or claimed as tested.

`expected-reference.json` records the visible reference blocks described by the
user. It represents only the visible portion of teaching week 8, not an entire
semester timetable. No period clock times are inferred.
